checks.result: The 72-file Python format/lint/type scope, nine-record ADR registry over 23 changed paths, 13-area architecture contract, 356-task backlog, and generated planning views all passed. ADR-0009 records the private token channel while preserving ADR-0008 process supervision and the reference-only UI boundary.

evidence: The native host generates 32 random bytes per launch with the Windows operating-system CSPRNG, encodes them canonically, transfers them only through inherited stdin before the suspended child resumes, retains them only with the owned process, and zeroes both durable and temporary native buffers with volatile writes.

Core parses one bounded lowercase-hex startup record before binding, retains only its SHA-256 digest, disables proxy-header interpretation, and requires numeric loopback peer identity, one exact numeric Host authority, absent Origin, and one current canonical Bearer value for every HTTP endpoint including readiness.

A real frozen process denies the stale credential and publishes no token in its handshake, response, logs, or stderr. Restart creates a new native token; missing, stale, malformed, duplicate, remote, origin-bearing, and authority-confused requests fail with fixed no-store responses.

Expected-path coverage spans in-process ASGI, real Uvicorn, real Python supervision, native unit tests, the deterministic process-tree fixture, and the exact frozen release-path artifact rather than a mock-only boundary.

Material denials include missing/wrong/noncanonical/duplicate credentials, malformed startup record, remote peer, cross-origin request, wrong Host, token rotation, early exit, timeout, cancellation, crash/retry, and immediate descendant cleanup.

Risk-based task verification selected service authentication, native lifecycle, package, performance, quality, ADR, architecture, backlog, and generated-view checks. The complete service and security-local profiles remain deferred to S04 slice review; a live security scan reproduced only the five already-recorded Node/Tauri capability blockers and reported zero secret findings.

Accepted ADR-0009 makes the token-generation, private-transfer, authority/origin, hosted-adapter, cleanup, and rollback boundaries explicit without rewriting the accepted ADR-0008 supervision decision.

Core and contract documentation now state that the handshake nonce is public process binding rather than authentication, the launch credential is absent from portable contracts and renderer APIs, and unsupervised Core denies HTTP by default.

The governed quality inventory includes the new middleware. The original development-root package attestation remains immutably visible and is explicitly superseded by the canonical release-root attestation; the new package was compared against unchanged S03 performance values before its baseline identity was updated.
